ازدرعا (form VIII)
# اِزْدَرَعَا (izdaraʕā) /iz.da.ra.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
# اُزْدُرِعَا (uzduriʕā) /uz.du.ri.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
# اِزْدَرِعَا (izdariʕā) /iz.da.ri.ʕaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
